scripts.deploy:evolution: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.evolution.jsonc
scripts.test: node --test worker/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p '*_test.py'
scripts.types:worker: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --env-interface CloudflareBindings --include-runtime false
scripts.typecheck:worker: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --env-interface CloudflareBindings --include-runtime false --check && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json
